'''Stage III Rooters''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns after a [[Stage II Rooter]] evolves.
*If at least one [[Colony]] exists, spawns when a [[Stage IV Rooter]] is killed.

== ''Behavior'' ==
WIP 

*Stage III Rooters throw 6 bombs around them when damaged, this has a cooldown of 5 seconds. These bombs inflict 14 damage each and place an effect cloud of stacking [[Viral]] and Poison.
*Stage III Rooters can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 7, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.
*Stage III Rooters can permanently upgrade parasites by increasing their [[Generations|generation]] to max value.
*Stage III Rooters will hide their tentacles if the terrain around them is too small.
*Stage III Rooters will apply the following effects to parasites:
**[[Pivot]] III (0:15)
**[[Parate]] III (0:15)
*Stage III Rooters can summon [[Rootmass Cyst|Rootmass Cysts]] when receiving damage.
* Upon death, if at least one [[Colony]] exists in the dimension, Stage III Rooters will turn into [[Stage II Rooter|Stage II Rooters]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Stage III Rooters, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Stage III Rooters have another hitbox at the top of their body, any damage done in this part of its body will be tripled and has a chance to cause [[Bleeding]].
